bio.text: Erik Kiehle is the Libertarian candidate for Mississippi's 3rd Congressional District in the 2026 election.

In a Mississippi Free Press candidate questionnaire, Kiehle said he was born and mostly raised in California and earned a bachelor's degree in business administration from the University of California, Riverside.
In the same questionnaire, Kiehle said he moved to Meridian, Mississippi, in 2017, has worked as a property manager since 2018 and is a certified volunteer firefighter.
